$description: theme: light. A separately tuned ramp, not an inversion of the dark one (A.2.3). These arrived as sRGB from the household's own design system rather than being authored in OKLCH, so A.2.1's OKLCH-first rule is met for the dark theme and not yet for this one; converting the hex back into OKLCH here would manufacture a precision nobody authored. Only colour is overridden, because A.1.6 scopes theme to colour only.

11.$description: Low-contrast text. The ramp runs the other way in this theme, so the text steps are the dark end.

ring.$description: A.5: the ring is measured against the surface of least contrast with it, which is the lightest step in the dark theme and the darkest in this one.
